question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1 i.e. 'its'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"its"** is the **possessive pronoun** that fits correctly because the sentence discusses something (a product or brand) owning or having something else (USP, packaging, etc.).
 
• It clearly denotes possession in the singular form, aligning with the subject of a product or brand.
 
• The use of **"its" **maintains the grammatical accuracy of the sentence, ensuring the passage is coherent and correctly framed.

**Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options **("their", "there", "it’s")** are incorrect due to issues of singular-plural agreement ("their"), inappropriate usage ("there"), and contraction versus possession confusion ("it’s" = It is).

**Complete Passage is:Today**, there are numerous products available for customers to select from, whether they are using a physical store or **an **online shopping platform. Almost every product or brand has **its **own USP, packaging, colour combinations and more as marketing tactics, which it uses to market itself to the customers in a (4)__________ manner. Brands find it (5)________ challenging to engage consumers as their attention spans are dwindling at an accelerated rate
